name: Kátoly (Hungary)
description: White field with a narrow blue stripe along the top edge and blue chevron-shaped stripes along the bottom edge, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Kátoly (a blue shield with a yellow crown, a rose and a scroll inscribed KÁTOLY, with blue and yellow mantling).
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
